name: Day Camp and Youth Service Volunteer
org: City of Surrey Parks, Recreation and Culture
what_you_do: Help staff run sport, art, dance, drama, science and themed day camps and youth programs at Surrey rec centres.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older. You must have the right to volunteer in Canada.
duration: At least 30 volunteer hours across the year
deadline_text: Not stated on the page read. Check for the next intake.
how_to_apply: Fill in a form on MyImpactPage. Go to an interview. Send 2 references. Get a Police Information Check. It can take up to 6 weeks.
notes: Contact volunteer@surrey.ca or 604-598-5863. The page says interview slots are available to sign up for, but shows no dates. Intake status is unclear, so confirm first.
